name: getFlagShow
description: Returns whether Hierarchical Progressive Survey (HiPS) images are currently displayed.
returnDescription: true if HiPS surveys are visible, false if hidden

name: setFlagShow
description: Shows or hides all Hierarchical Progressive Survey (HiPS) images.

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: true to show HiPS surveys, false to hide

name: loadSources
description: Starts loading the default HiPS survey sources from the network. This is called automatically when Stellarium starts if at least one survey was visible in the previous session. Can be called manually to force a reload of the survey list.

name: getFlagShowAtmosphericExtinction
description: Returns whether HiPS surveys are rendered with atmospheric extinction (they fade near the horizon based on the atmosphere model).
returnDescription: true if atmospheric extinction is applied to HiPS images, false otherwise

name: setFlagShowAtmosphericExtinction
description: Enables or disables atmospheric extinction for HiPS surveys. When enabled, survey images fade near the horizon according to the current atmosphere model, which produces a more realistic blend with the sky.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: true to enable atmospheric extinction (realistic fading), false to disable (uniform brightness)
